svg.text: Earthworks — ground shaping, ditches, foxholes (DESIGN_Ground_Patches_And_Road_Blockage.md §4a, §4c, §4c-1, §4d; house style)

Scope: the Earthworks group, the Ground / Ditch / Foxhole drawing and their Details, the cover points. Context (Add Entity, the map, the draw panel, the hint backdrop) is UNCHANGED. Grey notes are not drawn by the app.
A — Add Entity ▸ the NEW Earthworks group, beside the six terrain groups (one family, G-30: the same picks and the point / line / area tools)
Draw an area; the ground inside
rises, its edge blends over a skirt.
Houses and roads in it are kept
The SAME gallery and pane (§15a U-1); NEW: the Earthworks group (its icon in the sidebar like the six) and seven tiles, each naming its TOOL — an area, a line or a click — and its class (G-31:
TERRAIN = heights only, never a blocker G-15 · OBSTACLE = heights + a navmesh area + cover points). Glyph tiles stand in for thumbnails, as on the other terrain groups.
B — drawing a Ground area (Raise by 2.5 m): the live preview, the islands, the grade hint
steepest road grade 18 % (over 15 %) — roads follow; SUMO's net after save
Ground — click to add a point
The polygon is the existing area tool (U-7). NEW: the tint of the CHANGE (the 2-D map draws no heights today — P-3),
the dashed skirt, the two ISLANDS outlined white, the Mode row in the draw panel, and the hint lines on the shared ghost
backdrop: amber over ~15 % (G-19 — shown, never refused), else green ( steepest road grade 6 % — roads follow; … ).
Newest wins where shapes overlap (V-28). Our road graph and navmesh follow at once; SUMO's cars and the drawn road
ribbon keep the old z until save + reload (V-25).
C — Details of a Ground feature (a NEW tab, label-first)
dZ — Level reads Level to [212.0 m]
kept out: 1 house + skirt · 1 road corridor
drawn over Raise 1 — the newest wins (V-28)
SUMO net re-elevated at save (our roads follow now)
Crater is not a ground shape: it saves a crater RECORD
(obstacle class — a navmesh area, rim cover, the road
closure), V-14 over G-14. The form then shows its
radius and depth, and the tile Crater (authored) is its click.
Mode, height and skirt are the sibling GroundFeature component (V-27 —
TerrainFeature's 4 fields are not enough). Every edit = one
undo step and one live bake, like a placed house (§18e B).
D — a Ditch drawn with the line tool, and its Details
The line is the wall / fence / hedge tool (U-7); NEW: the ditch drawn as a dug band, its floor
points (the existing cover marker: a dot by stance + a tick toward the cover), and the stop at
the locked road corridor — a roadside ditch runs beside it; a culvert is later.
(floor points, a pair facing each bank — V-30)
(every vehicle avoids a ditch area — D-2)
Anti-tank ditch: ≥ 3 m wide, ≥ 1.5 m deep (G-28); Foxhole: below.
Stance by depth: ≥ 1.5 stand · ≥ 0.9 crouch · ≥ 0.45 prone (G-27).
E — a Foxhole: a click, then the heading (R turns)
a foxhole will not form here
The point tool (U-2: click, R = a quarter turn, drag turns).
The amber line shows on a grid coarser than ~1.5 m (G-37);
on a 1 m grid it is green: 1 m grid — a ≈ 3 × 3 m dip.
F — context for the cover rule: a crater's rim, after 60 s (G-35)
A man already in it is hidden
A crater is a runtime RECORD (P-4) or an authored one (V-14) — not
an Earthworks shape. Drawn here only for the cover rule.
